text: Advice. She gave me some good advice about the interview.
Recommend. I recommend the small company. You learn more.
Network. Half of the internships come from your network.
Visa. You should apply for the visa three months before.
Appointment. I have an appointment at the consulate on Monday.
Contact. You could contact them again next week.
Organise. You should organise your documents in one folder.
Warn. She warned me that the queue is always long.
I sent the application ten days ago and nobody answered. Should I write again?
Yes, you should. Ten days is a long time. But you could also ask somebody from your network first.
I do not really have a network.
You do. Your cousin worked there. She might know who reads the applications.
That feels like cheating.
It is not. Everybody does it. And a small warning: you should not write on a Friday afternoon.
Why not?
Because nobody reads anything after two on a Friday. My aunt warned me about that and she was right.
Okay. And the visa for January?
That one you must do now. The appointment takes six weeks. Not should — must.
I think you should book it this week.
You could always contact them again.
If I were you, I would start with the visa.
That is good advice — thank you.
I see what you mean, but I would rather do it the other way.

You asked me what to do before you go, so here is everything, and please listen to the first one. You must book the visa appointment now. Not next month, now, because it takes about six weeks and January is closer than you think. After that, money: you should not take much cash, it makes you nervous and it is not safe, and you could open one of those cards that work abroad, it takes ten minutes online. And one warning, because nobody told me this. The first week you might feel completely lost, and you are going to think you made a mistake. Everybody feels that. It passes in about five days.

Good morning. Please listen carefully before your appointment. You must bring three things: your passport, the printed form, and the payment receipt. If any one of those is missing, we cannot see you, and you will have to book another appointment, which currently takes six weeks. Now, separately, we recommend two things. You should arrive about thirty minutes early, because the queue outside is not covered and it often rains. And you should bring a photocopy of everything, even though we do not officially require it. It has saved a lot of people a lot of time. Thank you.
